mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message(session_id, request_id, role, status, content, stage) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{requestId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{content}, #{stage})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.request_id AS requestId, m.role, m.content, m.status, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.stage, f.feedback FROM chat_message m LEFT JOIN message_feedback f ON f.message_id = m.id AND f.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY m.id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT m.id, m.session_id AS sessionId, m.request_id AS requestId, m.role, m.status, m.content, m.stage, m.model_name AS modelName, m.token_count AS tokenCount, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chat_message m INNER JOIN chat_session s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE m.request_id = #{requestId} AND m.role = 'assistant' AND s.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.session_id AS sessionId, m.request_id AS requestId, m.role, m.status, m.content, m.stage, m.created_at AS createdAt, m.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM chat_message m INNER JOIN chat_session s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE m.id = #{messageId} AND m.role = 'assistant' AND s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET status = 'COMPLETED', content = #{content}, stage = NULL, model_name = #{modelName}, token_count = #{tokenCount}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{messageId} AND status = 'STREAMING'
UPDATE chat_message SET status = 'FAILED', content = #{content}, stage = NULL, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{messageId} AND status = 'STREAMING'

UPDATE chat_message m INNER JOIN chat_request r ON r.id = m.request_id SET m.status = 'INTERRUPTED', m.stage = NULL, m.updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE m.request_id = #{requestId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND m.role = 'assistant' AND m.status = 'STREAMING'
